title: Avocado Cream Uses: Face, Neck, Hands, Heels and Where Not to Use It
ex: Practical avocado cream uses beyond the face: neck, hands, elbows, knees and dry heels, after waxing, where not to use it, and which jar suits each use.
rt: Avocado Cream Uses: Face, Neck, Hands and Heels | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado cream uses explained: face at night, under sunscreen, neck, hands, elbows, dry heels and after threading, plus where not to use it and jar life.
quick: Avocado cream works as a night moisturiser for the face, a light morning cream under sunscreen, and a softening cream for the neck, hands, elbows, knees and dry heels. Don't use it on lips, broken skin, eyelids or babies, and skip kojic acid creams for a day or two after waxing or threading.
facts: Creams with kojic acid need sunscreen on top in the day.
Use avocado cream on dry heels as a moisturiser; deep or painful cracks need a doctor.
After waxing or threading, use a plain cream without kojic acid for a day or two.
Using it on the neck and hands too roughly halves how long a jar lasts.
